subject: general
question: NABARD is an apex finance institution set up by the Indian Government in 1982. What does 'R' in NABARD stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rural.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NABARD** stands for **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.**
 
• It was set up by the **Government of India in 1982** with the mandate of promoting **sustainable and equitable agriculture** and **rural development.**
